outcome: NICU admission or transfer out of facility
cohort: The study included 223,837 patients with singleton live births from an electronic birth certificate database from 2010 to 2022 in Central New York.
finding: Maternal BMI >= 50 kg/m2 was significantly associated with increased pregnancy complications, including higher likelihood of APGAR scores <7, NICU admission, pregestational diabetes, gestational diabetes, chronic hypertension, gestational hypertension, and preterm birth (<37 weeks and <34 weeks).
mod_finding: Patients with BMI > 50 kg/m2 had an increased odds of cesarean section.
